title: ARG Financial Governance Event
description: Unified event schema for all financial governance decisions: wallet lifecycle transitions, circuit breaker firing, fan-out detection, and purpose classification violations. Every event is signed and emitted to the telemetry pipeline. Downstream systems reconstruct the full financial audit trail from this stream.

event_type.description: The financial governance event that occurred

wallet_id.description: Wallet instance this event relates to

execution_tree_id.description: Agent execution tree this event relates to

agent_id.description: Specific agent within the execution tree that triggered this event

purpose_snapshot.description: Snapshot of the wallet's purpose classification at the time of this event. This is the color-of-money record: what was this spend authorized for, and who signed off. Present on every event so the audit trail is self-contained without requiring wallet lookups.

appropriation_id.description: The appropriation this spend draws from

intent_declaration.description: Declared intent at wallet issuance time

primary_authorizer_id.description: ID of the originating authorizer from the authorization chain

authorization_age_seconds.description: Seconds elapsed since the originating authorization was granted. Auditors use this to verify spend occurred within the authorization window.

spend_snapshot.description: Point-in-time financial state of the wallet at the moment this event fired

tokens_consumed.description: Total tokens consumed at time of event

cost_consumed_usd.description: Total cost in USD at time of event

token_limit.description: Token limit at time of event

cost_limit_usd.description: Cost limit at time of event

utilization_percent.description: Percentage of budget consumed at time of event

tokens_this_call.description: Tokens consumed in the specific call that triggered this event

cost_this_call_usd.description: Cost of the specific call that triggered this event

operation_type.description: The operation wallet category of the call that triggered this event

fan_out_detail.description: Present when event_type is FAN_OUT_DETECTED or FAN_OUT_SUPPRESSED. Captures the specific fan-out pattern detected.

call_count_in_window.description: Number of API calls observed in the detection window

window_seconds.description: Duration of the detection window in seconds

calls_per_minute_rate.description: Calculated call rate at time of detection

unique_endpoints_called.description: Number of distinct endpoints called in the detection window. High values indicate breadth fan-out.

repeated_endpoint_pattern.description: Whether the same endpoint was called repeatedly without forward progress. Indicates depth fan-out / loop.

suppression_action.description: Action taken when fan-out was suppressed

circuit_breaker_detail.description: Present when event_type is CIRCUIT_BREAKER_ARMED, CIRCUIT_BREAKER_FIRED, or CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET

breaker_name.description: Name of the circuit breaker that fired

trigger_signal.description: The signal that caused the breaker to arm or fire

cooldown_seconds.description: Cooldown period before circuit breaker can reset

purpose_mismatch_detail.description: Present when event_type is PURPOSE_MISMATCH_DETECTED. This is the color-of-money violation record.

declared_appropriation_id.description: The appropriation_id declared at wallet issuance

detected_appropriation_id.description: The appropriation_id inferred from the actual call pattern

mismatch_confidence.description: Confidence score (0.0 - 1.0) that a purpose mismatch has occurred

decision.description: The enforcement decision made in response to this event

decided_at.description: UTC timestamp of the enforcement decision

decision_latency_ms.description: Time taken to reach the decision in milliseconds. Used to verify sub-millisecond enforcement SLA.

policy_rules_evaluated.description: IDs of policy rules evaluated to reach this decision

requires_human_review.description: Whether this event requires human review before the execution tree can resume

signature.description: Cryptographic signature of this event. Same signing contract as the telemetry crypto-signature block. See community/key-management.md.
